rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for smoke-like or harmful vapour that is unpleasant or dangerous to breathe.

example.english: The factory's fume is very pungent, so everyone has to wear masks.
example.traditional: 工廠排出嘅煙霧好刺鼻，大家都要戴口罩。
example.jyutping: gung1 cong2 paai4 ceot1 ge3 jin1 mou6 hou2 ci3 bei6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 daai3 hau2 zaau3

rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for someone’s anger or hot temper when it affects their self-control.

example.english: When they fume, they lose control and start yelling at people.
example.traditional: 佢一有火氣就控制唔到自己，周圍鬧人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 jau5 fo2 hei3 zau6 hung3 zai3 m4 dou3 zi6 gei2 zau1 wai4 naau6 jan2
